caption:
The cheapest refusal to avoid: your passport was never eligible in the first place.

Validity rules differ by destination. Some require months of remaining validity beyond your return date. Some require the passport to have been issued within a set period. Some require blank pages.

None of that is checked at booking. It is checked at submission — and at the gate.

Our free checker confirms it in seconds.

slides.body: Your file is never assessed on merit. It fails before anyone reads your cover letter.

slides.headline: WHAT GETS CHECKED
items: Remaining validity beyond your intended departure
How recently the passport was issued
Blank pages available for the visa and stamps
Damage, or an unreadable data page
Name matching every other document exactly

slides.headline: CHECK THE PASSPORT BEFORE YOU CHECK ANYTHING ELSE.
